from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(x != bg for x in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]

    non_bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg)
    line_color = non_bg.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color != line_color and all(x == color for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    threshold = 0.70

    # Identify the repeated divider color from nearly uniform rows/columns.
    evidence = Counter()
    for row in grid:
        counts = Counter(row)

        if n / w >= threshold:
            evidence[color] += n / w
    for c in range(w):
        counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))
        color, n = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        if n / h >= threshold:
            evidence[color] += n / h
    divider = evidence.most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h)
            if sum(v == divider for v in grid[r]) / w >= threshold]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) / h >= threshold]

    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider).most_common(1)[0][0]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            out_row.append(color if color != divider and all(v == color for v in corners) else background)
        result.append(out_row)

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)

    # Divider color occurs as the dominant color in a small, repeated set
    # of complete horizontal and vertical separator lines.
    candidates = []
    for color in colors:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == color for v in grid[r]) >= 0.7 * w]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.7 * h]
        if len(rows) >= 2 and len(cols) >= 2:
            candidates.append((len(rows) + len(cols), color, rows, cols))

    _, divider, rows, cols = min(candidates)

    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider).most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
